# Pull Request Template

## Description
Describe the changes you're proposing and why.

## Task ID
Include the relevant task ID (e.g., P0-02, P0-03).

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Test addition
- [ ] Other

## Checklist
- [ ] I have read the relevant documentation
- [ ] My change is consistent with the project's approved architecture
- [ ] I have added or updated tests as appropriate
- [ ] I have verified existing tests still pass
- [ ] I have updated the individual progress log
- [ ] I have checked for secrets (no `.env` values, tokens, or credentials in diff)
- [ ] No application source files outside my assigned module are changed
- [ ] I have not committed or pushed to `main`

## Files Changed
List all files changed with a brief description of what changed:

## Test Results
List test commands run and their actual output:

## Screenshots/Evidence
Attach screenshots or command output proving the change works (especially for UI/integration changes).

## Blockers
List any blockers or open questions requiring discussion.

## Reviewer
@reviewer-username or leave blank for lead assignment
